exams.name: First Division Examination (Fundamentals of Engineering)
exams.notes: Required for engineer-in-training certification; tests fundamental engineering subjects including mathematics and basic sciences.
exams.jurisdiction: state board administers; may contract with public or private organization
exams.quote: The first division of the examination shall test the applicant's knowledge of appropriate fundamental engineering subjects, including mathematics and the basic sciences

exams.name: Second Division Examination (Principles and Practice of Engineering)
exams.notes: Required for licensure as professional engineer; tests ability to apply knowledge and assume responsible charge. For civil engineers, includes separate parts on seismic principles and engineering surveying principles.
exams.jurisdiction: state board administers; may contract with public or private organization
exams.quote: the second division of the examination shall test the applicant's ability to apply their knowledge and experience and to assume responsible charge in the professional practice of the branch of engineering in which the applicant is being examined

interval_years.quote: Certificates of registration as a professional engineer, and certificates of authority, shall be valid for a period of two years from the assigned date of renewal.

required.quote: At the time of renewal specified in Section 6795 or 6796, the board shall administer an assessment of the certificate holder to reinforce the certificate holder's knowledge of state laws and the board's rules and regulations.

available.quote: the board may issue a certificate of registration as a professional engineer, without written examination, to any person holding a certificate of registration issued to him or her by any state or country when the applicant's qualifications meet the requirements of this chapter and rules established by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false statement in a certification submission as a qualified professional certifier.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to report to the board in the time and manner required by this section shall be grounds for disciplinary action.

definition_quote.value: "Professional engineer," within the meaning and intent of this act, refers to a person engaged in the professional practice of rendering service or creative work requiring education, training and experience in engineering sciences and the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences in such professional or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning or design of public or private utilities, structures, machines, processes, circuits, buildings, equipment or projects, and supervision of construction for the purpose of securing compliance with specifications and design for any such work.
definition_quote.quote: "Professional engineer," within the meaning and intent of this act, refers to a person engaged in the professional practice of rendering service or creative work requiring education, training and experience in engineering sciences and the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences in such professional or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning or design of public or private utilities, structures, machines, processes, circuits, buildings, equipment or projects, and supervision of construction for the purpose of securing compliance with specifications and design for any such work.

methods_authorized.quote: consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning or design of public or private utilities, structures, machines, processes, circuits, buildings, equipment or projects, and supervision of construction for the purpose of securing compliance with specifications and design for any such work.

covers_land_surveying.quote: Civil engineers registered prior to January 1, 1982, shall be authorized to practice all land surveying as defined in Chapter 15 (commencing with Section 8700) of Division 3.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: An applicant for certification as an engineer-in-training shall, upon meeting all of the requirements prescribed in subdivisions (a) and (b) of Section 6751, be issued a certificate as an engineer-in-training.

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: May at its discretion give credit as qualifying experience not in excess of five years, for a postgraduate degree in a school of engineering with a board approved undergraduate or postgraduate curriculum.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: The phrase "responsible charge of work" means the independent control and direction, by the use of initiative, skill, and independent judgment, of the investigation or design of professional engineering work or the direct engineering control of such projects.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: All civil engineering plans and specifications that are permitted or that are to be released for construction shall bear the signature and seal or stamp of the licensee and the date of signing and sealing or stamping.

seal_document_types.quote: It is unlawful for anyone other than a professional engineer licensed under this chapter to stamp or seal any plans, specifications, plats, reports, or other documents with the seal or stamp of a professional engineer

firm_practice_allowed.quote: This chapter does not prohibit one or more civil, electrical, or mechanical engineers from practicing or offering to practice, within the scope of their license, civil (including geotechnical and structural), electrical, or mechanical engineering as a sole proprietorship, partnership, limited liability partnership, firm, or corporation

Contractors executing work designed by a licensed engineer (construction execution only)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A contractor licensed under Chapter 9 (commencing with Section 7000) of Division 3 is exempt from the provisions of this chapter relating to the practice of electrical or mechanical engineering so long as the services he or she holds himself or herself out as able to perform or does perform, which services are subject to the provisions of this chapter, are performed by, or under the responsible charge of a registered electrical or mechanical engineer

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Building trades workers, craft workers, and construction superintendents/supervisors/inspectors performing customary duties
Employees or subordinates working under direct supervision of a licensed engineer
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A subordinate to a civil, electrical or mechanical engineer licensed under this chapter, or a subordinate to a civil, electrical or mechanical engineer exempted from licensure under this chapter, insofar as he or she acts solely in that capacity, is exempt from licensure under the provisions of this chapter.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineers-in-training / engineer interns acting under supervision
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: An engineer-in-training certificate does not authorize the holder thereof to practice or offer to practice civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering work, in his or her own right

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Land surveyor interns
Teaching engineering, architectural, landscape architectural, or surveying courses at accredited institutions
Regulated transportation companies and public utilities (and their officers and employees) performing engineering for their own facilities
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Plans, specifications, reports and documents relating to communication lines and equipment prepared by employees of communications companies which come under the jurisdiction of the Public Utilities Commission, and by employees of contractors while engaged in work on communication equipment for communications companies which come under the jurisdiction of the Public Utilities Commission, are not subject to the provisions of this chapter.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineering services incidental to the practice of architecture by licensed architects and their subordinates
Engineering services incidental to the practice of geology by licensed geologists and their subordinates
Practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade
Manufacturing, mining, public utility, research and development, or other industrial corporations performing engineering work incidental to their own products, systems, or services
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: this chapter, except for those provisions that apply to civil engineers and civil engineering, shall not apply to the performance of engineering work by a manufacturing, mining, public utility, research and development, or other industrial corporation, or by employees of that corporation, provided that work is in connection with, or incidental to, the products, systems, or services of that corporation or its affiliates.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Firms performing engineering services for themselves or their own subsidiaries/affiliates (in-house engineering)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter does not require registration for the purpose of practicing civil engineering, by an individual, a member of a firm or partnership, or by an officer of a corporation on or in connection with property owned or leased by the individual, firm, partnership, or corporation, unless the civil engineering work to be performed involves the public health or safety

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Nonresident persons, firms, or corporations meeting specified out-of-state criteria
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person, firm, partnership, or corporation is exempt from registration under the provisions of this chapter who meets all the following: (a) Is a nonresident of the State of California. (b) Is legally qualified in another state to practice as a civil, electrical, or mechanical engineer. (c) Does not maintain a regular place of business in this state. (d) Offers to but does not practice civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering in this state.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Real estate brokers or salespersons making appraisals and valuations of real estate
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person, firm, or corporation holding a license as real estate broker or real estate salesperson, when making appraisals and valuations of real estate properties, while engaged in the business or acting in the capacity of a real estate broker or a real estate salesperson, within the meaning of the Real Estate Law is exempt from registration under the provisions of this chapter.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Alterations or repairs to buildings not affecting structural system or public health, safety, or welfare
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter does not prohibit any person, firm or corporation from furnishing, either alone or with subcontractors, labor and materials, with or without plans, drawings, specifications, instruments of service or other data covering such labor and materials: (a) For store fronts, interior alterations or additions, fixtures, cabinet work, furniture or other appliances or equipment.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Single-family and small residential dwellings of limited size
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter does not prohibit any person from preparing plans, drawings, or specifications for any of the following: (1) Single-family dwellings of woodframe construction not more than two stories and basement in height.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Agricultural work not required to be of public record
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Agricultural and ranch buildings of woodframe construction, unless the building official having jurisdiction deems that an undue risk to the public health, safety or welfare is involved.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Revegetation, restoration, reclamation, rehabilitation, or erosion control for disturbed land not affecting public health, safety, or welfare

Corporations, partnerships, LLCs, and LLPs offering professional engineering services through licensed principals (business entity exemption with certificate of authorization)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter does not prohibit one or more civil, electrical, or mechanical engineers from practicing or offering to practice, within the scope of their license, civil (including geotechnical and structural), electrical, or mechanical engineering as a sole proprietorship, partnership, limited liability partnership, firm, or corporation

Small public works projects below a specified expenditure threshold

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Boundary surveys on private land not intended as basis for engineering design
